mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms (room_id, user1, user2, created_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{user1}, #{user2}, #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id, user1, user2, created_at FROM chat_rooms WHERE (user1 = #{user1} AND user2 = #{user2}) OR (user1 = #{user2} AND user2 = #{user1}) LIMIT 1

SELECT cr.id, cr.room_id, cr.user1, cr.user2, cr.created_at FROM chat_rooms cr WHERE cr.user1 = #{userId} OR cr.user2 = #{userId} ORDER BY ( SELECT MAX(cm.timestamp) FROM chat_messages cm WHERE cm.room_id = cr.room_id ) DESC

SELECT r.id AS reservationId, p.post_id AS postId, p.title AS postTitle, (SELECT image_url FROM post_images WHERE post_id = p.post_id ORDER BY image_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS thumbnailUrl FROM reservations r JOIN posts p ON r.post_id = p.post_id WHERE (r.member_id = #{user1} AND p.user_id = #{user2}) OR (r.member_id = #{user2} AND p.user_id = #{user1}) ORDER BY (r.status = 'CONFIRMED') DESC, r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
